import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62_txt="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
Lx=B62_txt.strip().split('\n'); hdr=Lx[0].split(); B62={}
for l in Lx[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def local_align(s,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s),len(t); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8); best=(0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        si=s[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc(si,t[j-1]); c=(M[i-1,j-1]+d,Ix[i-1,j-1]+d,Iy[i-1,j-1]+d,0.0)
            k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]; ptr[i,j,0]=k
            cx=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(cx)); Ix[i,j]=cx[k]; ptr[i,j,1]=k
            cy=(M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(cy)); Iy[i,j]=cy[k]; ptr[i,j,2]=k
            if M[i,j]>best[0]: best=(M[i,j],i,j)
    score,i,j=best; st=0; As=[];At=[];ps=[];pt=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0:
            if M[i,j]<=0: break
            k=ptr[i,j,0]
            if k==3: break
            As.append(s[i-1]);At.append(t[j-1]);ps.append(i);pt.append(j); i-=1;j-=1; st=k if k<3 else 0
        elif st==1:
            k=ptr[i,j,1]; As.append(s[i-1]);At.append('-');ps.append(i);pt.append(None); i-=1; st=1 if k==1 else 0
        else:
            k=ptr[i,j,2]; As.append('-');At.append(t[j-1]);ps.append(None);pt.append(j); j-=1; st=2 if k==1 else 0
    return dict(score=score,a=''.join(reversed(As)),b=''.join(reversed(At)),ps=list(reversed(ps)),pt=list(reversed(pt)))
def uget(a):
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()
    return j['sequence']['value']
def by_name(name,taxid):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={
      "query":f"{name} AND organism_id:{taxid}","fields":"accession,sequence,length","format":"json","size":"5"},timeout=90).json()
    for e in r.get('results',[]):
        if 'sequence' in e and 250<=e['sequence']['length']<=600: return e['primaryAccession'],e['sequence']['value']
    return None,None

CR=uget('A2T2X4'); N147=CR[:147]
sp={'Homo sapiens':('Q9NQC8','motile'),'Danio rerio':('Q6DRN0','motile'),
    'Xenopus tropicalis':('Q28H29','motile'),'Trypanosoma brucei':('Q57UX3','motile'),
    'Caenorhabditis elegans':('Q0G838','nematode'),'Brugia malayi':('A8PYM6','nematode'),
    'Strongyloides ratti':('A0A090LGF7','nematode')}
seqs={}
for k,(a,g) in sp.items():
    try: seqs[k]=(uget(a),g)
    except Exception: print("skip",k,a)
for nm,tx,g in [('IFT46',10090,'motile'),('IFT46',9986,'motile'),('IFT46',6183,'motile')]:
    acc,s=by_name(nm,tx)
    if s: seqs[{10090:'Mus musculus',9986:'Oryctolagus cuniculus',6183:'Schistosoma mansoni'}[tx]]=(s,g); print("added",tx,acc,len(s))
cols={k:[None]*147 for k in seqs}
for k,(s,g) in seqs.items():
    r=local_align(s,N147)
    m={pt:s[ps-1] for ps,pt in zip(r['ps'],r['pt']) if ps and pt}
    cols[k]=[m.get(j) for j in range(1,148)]
mot=[k for k in seqs if seqs[k][1]=='motile']; nem=[k for k in seqs if seqs[k][1]=='nematode' and k!='Caenorhabditis elegans']
print("motile:",mot,"| other nematodes:",nem)
fm=np.array([np.mean([cols[k][j-1]==N147[j-1] for k in mot]) for j in range(1,148)])
fn=np.array([np.mean([cols[k][j-1]==N147[j-1] for k in nem]) for j in range(1,148)])
ce=np.array([cols['Caenorhabditis elegans'][j-1]==N147[j-1] for j in range(1,148)],float)
cecov=np.array([cols['Caenorhabditis elegans'][j-1] is not None for j in range(1,148)],float)
W=15
w=pd.DataFrame([(j,fm[j-1:j+W-1].mean(),fn[j-1:j+W-1].mean(),ce[j-1:j+W-1].mean(),cecov[j-1:j+W-1].mean())
                for j in range(1,148-W+2)],columns=['start','motile_id','nem_id','ce_id','ce_cov'])
print("\nTop 15-residue windows by motile-ortholog identity:")
print(w.sort_values('motile_id',ascending=False).head(5).round(3).to_string(index=False))
j0=int(w.sort_values('motile_id',ascending=False).iloc[0].start)
print(f"\nWindow CrIFT46 {j0}-{j0+W-1}  ref: {N147[j0-1:j0+W-1]}")
for k in mot+['Caenorhabditis elegans']+nem:
    print("   %-24s %s"%(k,''.join(cols[k][j-1] or '.' for j in range(j0,j0+W))))
print("\nCoverage/identity over CrIFT46 1-147:")
rows=[]
for k in mot+['Caenorhabditis elegans']+nem:
    al=[j for j in range(1,148) if cols[k][j-1] is not None]
    idd=np.mean([cols[k][j-1]==N147[j-1] for j in al]) if al else 0
    rows.append((k,seqs[k][1],len(al),round(len(al)/147,2),round(idd,3)))
    print("   %-24s %-9s %3d/147 (%.2f) aligned, %.3f id over aligned"%(k,seqs[k][1],len(al),len(al)/147,idd))
from scipy import stats
print("\nMann-Whitney (per-position identity to CrIFT46, 1-147), motile > nematode: p=%.2e  (means %.3f vs %.3f)"%(
    stats.mannwhitneyu(fm,fn,alternative='greater')[1],fm.mean(),fn.mean()))
# internal control: C-terminal domain, same species set
CT=CR[197:]
ctr={}
for k,(s,g) in seqs.items():
    r=local_align(s,CT); m={pt:s[ps-1] for ps,pt in zip(r['ps'],r['pt']) if ps and pt}
    al=[j for j in range(1,len(CT)+1) if j in m]
    ctr[k]=(len(al)/len(CT), np.mean([m[j]==CT[j-1] for j in al]) if al else 0)
print("\nInternal control, CrIFT46 C-terminal 198-%d:"%len(CR))
for k in mot+['Caenorhabditis elegans']+nem: print("   %-24s %.2f aligned, %.3f id"%(k,ctr[k][0],ctr[k][1]))
mC=np.mean([ctr[k][1] for k in mot]); nC=np.mean([ctr[k][1] for k in nem+['Caenorhabditis elegans']])
mN=fm.mean(); nN=np.mean([np.mean([cols[k][j-1]==N147[j-1] for j in range(1,148)]) for k in nem+['Caenorhabditis elegans']])
print("\nNematode/motile identity ratio:  N-terminal (1-147) %.2f   C-terminal (198-end) %.2f"%(nN/mN, nC/mC))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.4),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[3,1]})
ax[0].plot(range(1,148),pd.Series(fm).rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(),color='#1f77b4',lw=2.2,label='motile-cilia orthologs (n=%d)'%len(mot))
ax[0].plot(range(1,148),pd.Series(fn).rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(),color='#d62728',lw=2.2,label='other nematodes (n=%d)'%len(nem))
ax[0].plot(range(1,148),pd.Series(ce).rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(),color='k',lw=1.5,ls='--',label='C. elegans DYF-6')
ax[0].axvspan(j0,j0+W-1,color='gold',alpha=.35,zorder=0)
ax[0].set_ylabel('fraction identical to CrIFT46\n(9-residue smoothing)'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1)
ax[0].set_title('ODA16-binding region of IFT46 (Chlamydomonas 1-147): conservation per position.\nGold band = best-conserved 15-residue window (%d-%d, %s)'%(j0,j0+W-1,N147[j0-1:j0+W-1]),fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar(range(1,148),cecov,color='#2ca02c',width=1.0,label='aligned in DYF-6')
ax[1].bar(range(1,148),ce,color='k',width=1.0,label='identical in DYF-6')
ax[1].axvspan(j0,j0+W-1,color='gold',alpha=.35,zorder=0)
ax[1].set_xlabel('CrIFT46 residue'); ax[1].set_ylabel('DYF-6'); ax[1].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
